content: Woo kaŋ Pool ŋ fiki Yawuut ca ŋ Yerusalem
« Taambɗoh ciŋ ngo na baab ciŋ ngo, sikɗukaat kotii ini maa hee ɗu woye ŋ yambi ɗu na yambee so. »
Wa ɓa kerah ɗe woyeeɗa ŋ peɗmiŋ ɓa, ɓa ɓaatta ɗek. Pool taalndiɗta an :

« Mi, ŋ Yawuut, ŋ raakohu Tarsa ŋ Silisi, waaye ŋ koɗohu ndii, ŋ Yerusalem, te Gamaliyel a yi jangiɗ to waasiŋ caac ciŋ ɓoo, jangiɗ yurhiɗ. Ŋ sawarra lool ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kooh findi ɗu mand nga woti-woti, ɗu jen.
Ŋ meeɗta tolfiɗ ɓooɓiŋ waasiŋ Yeesu, po raakiɗ ɓi apu nga sah. Ŋ ambeeɗa ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, ŋ taƴeeɗa ŋ kaso.

Seeƴkiɗohi yakki na saangniŋ atte'oh ci jen miniɗ to seede ngaŋ ineem. Ɓa fiisɗeen ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo Yawuut ci nikee ŋ Damas kayit sah, ɓa teyɗukiɗta so ne ŋ kaɗ nga, ŋ amba ɓi aas ŋ waasiŋ Yeesu nga, ŋ ɓay ɓa Yerusalem, ɓa mbugalu.
Wi ŋ kooɗ waasi po ŋ heeɗa ree Damas, ŋ leero noh cong, ɗekka po ñiin pulohha Eel ci, wa willa so, wa siñaarɗeeɗa.
Ŋ keennda ŋ kehƴi, ŋ kerahha hooso woyeeɗa so ne : “ Sool, Sool, wa ye tah fu tolfiɗee so ? ”
Ŋ woosa ne : “ A fu ɓa Heɗi ? ” Hoosoori loffa so ne : “ E ñam Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet, yi fu na tolfiɗe. ”
Ɓooɓi hunee na so hoteen siñaari waaye ɓa kerheeɗi hoosoori woyee na so.
Ŋ meeksohha an : “ Heɗi, kon ŋ joy ye tum kotii ? ” Heɗi loffa so ne : “ Kurka fu kaɗ Damas, ndaam, fu hey woyse ini fu joy haɓiɗ jen. ”
Ŋ fuulee fuul sagu siñaara, ɓooɓa hunee na so ammba so ŋ yaah, ɓa nookeeɗa so po ŋ reesa Damas.
Raakeen ƴaar nga teeku Anañaas, a nikee ɓo' kosiɗ Kooh, yi meeɗ taambiɗ waasiŋMusaa te Yawuut caŋ Damas jen seede'een ɗe seede moɗiɗ.
A hayya so raake, a reɓpa nga so, a woosa so ne : “ Sool, ɓaahiŋ ngo, hotissa ! ” Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska ŋ hotisseeɗa, ŋ hotta ɗe.
Ŋ ineem, a woosa so ne : “ Koohiŋ caaciŋ ɓoo kooɗiɗ ɗa maañ ne fu inah ini a waaɗ, ne fu hot yi Yurhiɗi te fu kerah hoosooriŋ ɗe.
Laam fu nikan seedeeniŋ ɗe ŋ fiki ɓooɓi jen, ŋ ini fu hot, fu kerahhaa.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii, fu na seke ye ? Kurka, fu ɓoktu te fu kiim ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe ne fu hool ŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗa. ”
Wa ŋ dokuk Yerusalem, wa raakka mbeh, ŋ kiimeeɗa Kooh ŋ Kahan Kooh, in hayɗohha so haa heeƴ.
Ŋ hotta Heɗi, a woosa ne : “ Arra pul Yerusalem ! Laam ɓooɓi gen nga teyɗukanɗi seedeeniŋ ɗa ŋ ini kaɗ nga so. ”
Ŋ woosa ne : “ Heɗi, ɓa inhiɗ baahiɗ ne ŋ meeɗ meeɗ taambiɗ sinaagog ci, ŋ taƴɗukee ɓi kos ɗa, ŋ laɓɗukee ɓa.
Te wi seedeeniŋ ɗa Ecen na apse, ŋ nikee nga, mi ŋ haf fo. Ŋ huneen na ɓa ngaŋ apa ɓa apee ɗe te ñam ambɗee ɓa sah kulɓaacaŋ ɓa. ”
Ŋ ineem Heɗi woosa so ne : “ Kaɗa, mi, ŋ hey ɗa tuuƴe usiɗ, ŋ ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut ! ” »
Pool na kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca
Mboolnda nikee sikɗukeeɗa Pool po ŋ woo ciŋ ɗe mirndoh ceem, jaarra ɓa jen, ɓa leehkeeɗa an : « Apa ƴaarii ! Ɓo' mand an yeyyooɗi pes ! »
Ɓa looƴkeeɗa, ɓa wolla kulɓaacaŋ ɓa, ɓa gusñeeɗa merhey mi ŋ ɗafka.
Ŋ ndeem, kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca nakohha ne Pool ɓeku ŋ kahnaŋ soldaar ca, a laɓu leraw po a woo, ŋ ineem ɓo' inah ini tah Yawuut ci leehkee ɗe mand an.
Wa ɓa tok ɗe ne ɓa laɓ ɗe, a woosa ƴaara adgohee ɓa ne : « Andi waas oniɗ ɗu ne ɗu laɓ ɓoyi ɓaah ŋ Rom te raak ɗe atte'uuɗi paaɗ ? »
Wa soldaara kerah ineem a kaɗtaa woya kilifaana an : « Fu na hee haɓɗe ye an ? Ƴaarii ɓo' Rom ! »
Kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca hayya ŋ Pool, a meekissa ɗe ne : « Woyaa so, wa keeh ne fu ɓo' Rom e ? » Pool loffa ɗe ne : « Ee. »
Ŋ ndeem, kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca woosa ɗe ne : « Ŋ wirind kopor keeh-keeh ne nik ɓo' Rom. » Pool loffa ɗe : « Mi nak, ŋ rimu naa. »
Jaarra, soldaar ca hee ɗe laɓe ne a woo, faɗta ɗe ndeem cootta. Kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca nammba tiit, wa a inah ne a tokɗuk ɓo' Rom.
Pool ŋ fiki atte'ohaana yakka

Kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca waaɗta inah wooriɗ ina Yawuut ca yambee Pool. Weɗ tah wa Kooh wiis, a nakohha ne Pool pulɗu ɗiski a nik, a cohɗohha kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa na ɓooɓa ɓaah ŋ saangnaŋ yakak caŋ Israayel jen. A ɓayya Pool, a tufkiɗta ɗe ŋ fikiiɓa.
